name: Vesper Attack-Surface Management Platform
description: A premium single-page Tailwind CSS template for an external attack-surface management platform built for security teams. Glassmorphism surfaces meet Cyber Minimal discipline — translucent frosted panels over an atmospheric fuchsia/indigo/cyan mesh, Sora display type, JetBrains Mono metadata, a hand-built attack-surface command-console hero with a live surface radar and sparkline plus floating critical-exposure/new-asset mini-cards, a signature asset-topology reachability graph with an exposed path highlighted in cyan, a five-step signed-state EASM lifecycle workflow, dark customer-outcome metrics, security-leader testimonials, per-asset pricing, a scoped single-open FAQ accordion, and a glass conversion CTA with a three-step onboarding panel.
features: editorial-cyber split hero with attack-surface command-console visualization (live scanning status, severity bar, exposure rows, surface radar, exposures-per-day sparkline, floating critical-exposure + new-asset mini-cards)
atmospheric glassmorphism backdrop — translucent frosted panels over a low-opacity fuchsia/indigo/cyan mesh with slow drift + fine cyber-grid + vignette
three frosted-glass pillar panels (Discover / Prioritize / Remediate) with severity-colored icon chips
signature asset-topology reachability graph (internet → load balancer → API gateway → K8s API / Postgres / S3) with the exposed path animated in cyan and a critical-asset node in red
five-step EASM lifecycle workflow (Discover → Classify → Prioritize → Remediate → Verify) with per-step timings and a signed-state rail
dark customer-outcome metrics grid (MTTR, critical exposures, shadow assets, alert noise)
featured pull-quote testimonial + secondary security-leader testimonial cards
three-tier per-asset pricing with featured Team plan and Most-popular tag
scoped single-open FAQ accordion (CSS-grid animation, ARIA, keyboard)
glass conversion CTA with corner-tick framing and a three-step onboarding panel
six-column footer with live system-status indicator
sticky glass navbar with scoped vanilla-JS mobile menu (escape-safe)
consistent Glassmorphism + Cyber Minimal token system: translucent surfaces, 1px white hairlines, rounded-2xl glass, single cyan accent, amber/red/ok severity-only
semantic HTML, skip link, ARIA, visible focus states, and prefers-reduced-motion support
Tailwind CSS via CDN with no build step
